chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Beware of disobeying Allah in solitude, for the witness is the judge.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to fear Allah in solitude according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) exhorts believers to maintain God-consciousness even in solitude, emphasizing that the Divine Witness is also the ultimate Judge, a concept central to Shia ethical theology regarding *muraqaba* (awareness of God). This hadith underscores the integrity of the believer who remains consistent in piety whether in public or private, reflecting the Shia emphasis on inner sincerity (*ikhlas*) over outward performance. The warning against sin in 'solitude' (*al-khawat*) serves as a spiritual safeguard against hypocrisy, ensuring that divine accountability is internalized.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 324. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
Beware of disobeying Allāh in solitude, because the witness (of that situation) is also the judge.
